scope: Exactly Qwen3.5 Base 0.8B/2B/4B/9B at the four listed host175 paths for existing Base DEV engineering; no new dataset or model acceptance.
unchanged_storage_assumption: These exact host175 CephFS paths remained the same assets after historical accepted hashing; no host-side rewrite, path replacement, storage rollback/remap, restored metadata, privileged timestamp manipulation, or out-of-band mutation occurred. CephFS supplies normal trustworthy change-time semantics.
residual_limit: Undetected same-path replacement, rewrite, storage rollback/remap, metadata restoration, out-of-band mutation or nonstandard change-time behavior could invalidate inherited checkpoint identity. Read-only consumer mounts and old ctimes do not exclude that. Even a numerical pass on all three paths can occur on the same substituted checkpoint; it cannot establish historical byte identity.

validator_requirements.requirement: Authenticate this exact VERDICT.json and its SOURCEPINS through the final independently reviewed package pins; bind a model_tag to exactly one of the four allowlisted model/path/manifest rows. A caller-supplied acceptance boolean or a caller-chosen receipt is not authority.
validator_requirements.where: qualify.validate before the current unconditional raise

validator_requirements.requirement: Require CONFIG model and model_sha256, MODEL-MANIFEST path/manifest_sha256/files, and PLAN model/manifest fields to match the selected row. Canonical manifest digest remains the existing N.digest(files). Bind the exact historical plan and acceptance pins, plan_sha256/model_sha256 and evidence map using the named references; for 9B preserve its actual schema/bridge, not an invented top-level model field. Inherited per-file SHA256 values remain historical values.

Keep exact CONFIG, PLAN, package source, loader, runtime, upstream and small-asset pins. The small-asset receipt authenticates its source plan and config/index only; retain the existing non-safetensors checks for the finite manifest inventory, including tokenizer assets, without retokenization. Pin new decision metadata as package inputs and regenerate dependent CONFIG/PLAN/request pins. Do not hash weights or TEST data.
validator_requirements.where: existing package_files and upstream source checks

validator_requirements.requirement: Require the current inventory at the exact reviewed model path to equal the complete accepted file set; no missing or extra files, model substitutions, unreviewed mirror relocation or shard omission. Keep the exact [size,inode,mtime_ns,ctime_ns] checks against the pinned preparation baseline for every file. Do not create a fresh baseline to conceal drift. Use the saved host175 observation to label host and weight device identity; compare device/inode only in the same host/filesystem namespace. A changed namespace is unresolved identity, not proof of replacement. The saved observation is recent metadata, never historical stat-at-hash.
validator_requirements.where: existing model inventory and per-file stat loop

validator_requirements.requirement: Select this operational reuse mode explicitly and record its decision pin, selected manifest, historical authority pins, baseline/observation refs, checks and unchanged-storage assumption. Null historical-stat/immutable-version refs alone must not reject this mode. Any observed contradiction, changed/missing baseline, changed inventory, pin mismatch, known replacement/rewrite or small-file mismatch must reject the affected model before load. Do not claim a negative audit of all possible writers.
validator_requirements.where: asset policy result, before model load

validator_requirements.requirement: No numerical admission follows from asset reuse. Keep exact same-Base RC1 image, frozen inputs, three paths, full vectors, zero tolerances, generation identity, lifecycle/release and final independent package review gates. This decision supplies no lease, NPU launch, TEST, publication or scientific result approval.
validator_requirements.where: qualification/score/host unchanged scientific and lifecycle gates
